thread:
Sam (CEO): Quick follow-up from todays all-hands Q&A on wins/losses. Can folks post one-line reasons we won and one-line reasons we lost + one immediate next step we can take? Keep it short.

Marco (VP Product): Win: predictable latency and clear fallback policies. Loss: private deploy onboarding friction. Next step: 30d private quickstart + checklist.

Leah (Customer Success): Win: hands-on onboarding + sample integrations (Zendesk, CRM). Loss: pilot invoices / billing surprises. Next step: publish pilot billing FAQ + sample invoice (30d).

Ethan (Sales): Win: strong latency SLAs in demos = easy close. Loss: missing air-gapped docs and audit artifacts in RFPs. Next step: 30d audit bundle (SOC2 excerpt + KMS docs).

Ravi (Eng): Win: runtime perf on short-seq chat workloads. Loss: quantized model perf on long sequences causing missed SLOs. Next step: add long-seq perf smoke test in canary deploys (60d).

Ana (Legal): Win: customers like our contractual simplicity. Loss: customers asking for example contract language for pilot liability. Next step: 60d create pilot contract appendix template.

Marco (VP Product): Leadership asks: assign owners and a KPI for each item. I suggest pilot cycle time, RFP win-rate for security requests, and long-seq token latency 95p.

Leah (Customer Success): I'll own the pilot billing FAQ + collect three example invoices for redaction. @Ethan please DM the three recent cases.

Ethan (Sales): Will DM now. Also drafting AE one-pager for air-gap rebuttals  will share as gdoc.

Ravi (Eng): Eng will start the smoke-test spike this week. Tagging eng-runtime & eng-oncall for input.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-6210: "Audit bundle (SOC2 excerpt, KMS + network diagram)" assigned to Ethan + Ana, due in 30 days.

Sam (CEO): Thanks. Please put owners + tickets in here by EOD tomorrow. Leadership will review KPIs next week.

Marco (VP Product): I'll post owners + a consolidated 30/60/90 plan tomorrow AM. :rocket:

Leah (Customer Success): Quick ask: can we include a short checklist for "what to share with customer during RFP" in the audit bundle? Makes AEs' lives easier.

Ana (Legal): Good call. I'll add a redaction guide and example clause language to the bundle.

Marco (VP Product): Great  thanks everyone.

ops-bot: Note: thread will be archived after owners are posted.
